acceptance_commands: [ "$(grep -Ec '^# bound derivation: r=[1-9][0-9]*/s r_real=[1-9][0-9]*/s p_obs=[0-9]+\.[0-9][0-9] reference=400/s scale=[1-4] arm_cap=(120|240|360|480)s node_ceiling=[1-9][0-9]* floor=DISABLED$' "$RUN_OUT")" -eq 1 ]
